## laravel-ai-meter v0.1.0

First release — **self-hosted metering + budget enforcement for AI/LLM calls in Laravel**, with a built-in dashboard and **no external service**.

```bash
composer require nsd7/laravel-ai-meter
php artisan migrate
```

Then visit `/ai-meter`.

### Highlights
- **📊 Dashboard** (Blade + Tailwind, dark mode): spend today / month / all-time, spend-over-time chart, cost by model & provider, top scopes, and a filterable call log with per-call detail.
- **🧾 Cost attribution** from a bundled, overridable price book (unknown models use a configurable fallback — never silently $0).
- **🛑 Budget enforcement** per **user / tenant / global** over **run / day / month / total**, with `block` (HTTP 402 via the `ai.budget` middleware) or `alert`.
- **🔌 Reliable capture API** — `Meter::log()` and `Meter::recordPrism()`.
- **🔐 Safe by default** — optional, redacted and truncated prompt/response storage; dashboard behind an auth gate.
- **🗄️ Self-hosted** — stores in your database (MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite, SQL Server).

### Quality
- 26 passing tests, green on PHP 8.2–8.4 / Laravel 10–12.

### What's next (v0.2)
Auto-instrumentation adapters (Prism / Laravel AI SDK / Neuron), agent **runs** with a trace tree, and `Meter::run()` with per-run tool-call & wall-clock caps (the runaway-loop guard).

See [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/nowshad7/laravel-ai-meter/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).
